## Invitations

A total of 1790 invitations were issued. Attendance was 664, representing a rate of 37.1 per cent. The figures provide a clear summary of the response to the outreach activity and support continued review of how invitations are delivered and followed up. Van days were maintained where roads allowed, helping to sustain outreach activity despite local access conditions.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 1514 invitations. No reminder messages were recorded, with 0 people receiving a reminder message. The contact figures should be considered alongside attendance when reviewing the effectiveness of the invitation process. They also provide a basis for considering whether reminder arrangements could strengthen future engagement, while recognising the existing use of SMS and the practical limits affecting van days.

Prepared by G. Evans.
